title: Sadhguru Debunked: Pseudoscience Exposed
description:
When it comes to pseudoscience in India, few figures stand out like Jaggi Vasudev (Sadhguru). From claiming women with twins produce two kinds of breast milk, to saying evolution was understood by yogis 15,000 years ago, to insisting you shouldn’t eat during eclipses — his talks are a cocktail of superstition, word salad, and pseudo-astrophysics. Backed by slick vocabulary and Westernized delivery, Sadhguru has become one of the most influential promoters of pseudoscience today.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we critically examine Sadhguru’s claims about Mahashivaratri and his so-called “science.” We break down his bizarre explanations of precession, energy upsurges, tides, gravity, lunar effects, and evolution, exposing them against real science. From saying the solar system “creates your body like a potter’s wheel,” to asserting that lying down blocks cosmic energy, his statements collapse under scrutiny. We also show how he borrows real science terms — precision, energy, evolution — and smuggles them into mystical claims, distracting audiences like a stage magician

This video isn’t just about Sadhguru. It’s about how pseudoscience gets legitimized when spirituality dresses up in scientific jargon. By comparing his claims with established astronomy, biology, and neuroscience, we highlight why critical thinking matters more than ever. If India’s most followed guru can mislead millions with tidal nonsense and lunar lunacy, then questioning authority isn’t just a duty — it’s survival for a rational society.

If you’ve searched for Sadhguru debunked, Sadhguru pseudoscience, Mahashivaratri exposed, Sadhguru science claims fact check, pseudoscience in India, Sadhguru evolution claims, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations about science and skepticism.
